label: extract-lucario
source: rl/results/kpf_2026-09-26/diagnosis/workflow_scratch: slice membership from sk_luc_games.pkl (skeptic records built by sk_luc_lib.build, tick-split) with the predicates of sk_luc_c1.py (P1, P6) and sk_luc_c4.py (bare v evolved); these give DIAGNOSIS.md's printed counts exactly. k, tick, raw actions and boards cross-checked against luc_games.pkl / luc_rows.json (same k for every row). config from selected.json.

slice_definitions.bare_riolu: Fix A's Lucario slice. DIAGNOSIS s1 Lucario '... with a bare Riolu in front' 24/11 (sign p 0.04), s2/s3 'bare Riolu 24/11' in the pooled 48/16. Rule: at the end of Lucario's own turn T containing the first divergence (T = divergence turn, or the next turn when the divergence is a Promote in the opponent's turn), kpf's Active is Riolu AND kp3's Active is Bonsly or Hitmonlee. End board = board on the last EndTurn line of T by Lucario's seat (sk_luc_lib.turn_facts).
slice_definitions.forward_swap: Fix B's Lucario slice = Lucario's share of the pooled forward swaps 52/32 (syn_binom.py: Altaria 4/1 + Lucario 34/24 + Vespiquen 14/7). DIAGNOSIS s1 '... with Mega Lucario ex or Lucario in front' 34/24, s3 channel 2 'Mega Lucario ex or Lucario forward, 34/24'. Rule: same as bare_riolu but kpf's end Active is Mega Lucario ex or Lucario.
slice_definitions.hides: Reported, gates nothing. DIAGNOSIS s1 'Mirror: kpf puts a wall in front where kp3 leaves the Riolu line' 15/30 (sk_luc_c1 P6). Rule: kpf's end Active is Bonsly or Hitmonlee AND kp3's is Riolu, Mega Lucario ex or Lucario.
slice_definitions.forward_swap_all (not emitted as rows): DIAGNOSIS s1 58 fwd / 35 (sk_luc_c1 P1) = bare_riolu + forward_swap, disjoint; verified in the script. Do not pool it with the other two.

k_meaning: k = index of the first differing action line in the tick-split per-game trace (same index in dump_base and dump_kpf; board before it identical); tick = that line's DUMP2 tick; turn = its turn field; board_own/board_opp = the shared board before the move (Lucario's side / opponent's side). trace_occurrence = which tick-restart run of the seed in dump_kpf.txt is the Lucario game (1 = second copy).
